expedition.command.move.build_height: The box would leave the build height of %s.
expedition.command.move.dry_run.clear: Dry run: the move would go ahead, carrying %s blocks and %s block entities, mass %s. Nothing was changed.
expedition.command.move.dry_run.refused: Dry run: the move would be refused, with %s obstacles. Nothing was changed.
expedition.command.move.entities_left: %s entities in the box stayed behind: their teleport was refused.
expedition.command.move.failed: The move failed part-way through: %s. The server log has the details.
expedition.command.move.moved: Moved the box to %s in %s: %s blocks, %s block entities and %s entities, mass %s, in %s ticks (%s ms of work).
expedition.command.move.nowhere: The box would go nowhere: its lowest corner is already at %s.
expedition.command.move.refused: The move was refused, and nothing was changed: %s (%s)
expedition.command.move.started: Moving the box at %s to %s in %s. The result follows when the move is done.
expedition.command.planet.validate.chang: The files differ from the planets loaded now. /reload loads them.
expedition.command.planet.validate.summa: Checked %s planet files: %s planets would load, %s files wouldn't, and there are %s warnings. Nothing was changed.
expedition.configuration.border.tooltip: World borders at each planet's edge, with chunks far past them left empty. The border is centred on the planet's surface.center, space.size blocks a side. Chunks already generated are never changed.
expedition.configuration.borderEnabled.t: Give every planet a world border at its square's edge, and leave chunks far past it empty.
expedition.configuration.exclude.tooltip: Planets, by dimension id, left without a border even when planets are bounded, such as minecraft:overworld.
The most blocks a ship's box may be along any one axis. 64 is the largest size that has been measured; a longer side spans more chunks.
expedition.configuration.maxOverlappingH: The most blocks a ship's box may hold for a short hop, a move onto part of its own space. Such a hop is done in one server tick: a full 16×16×16 box costs that tick about 6–10 ms, and every 4,096 blocks more adds about as much.
expedition.configuration.maxVolume.toolt: The most blocks a ship's box may hold, air included. The default, 131,072, is 64×64×32: a full ship that size takes about 3 s a trip. 64×64×64 works, but takes about 6 s a trip and can bring lag spikes on a small heap.
expedition.configuration.endPortals.tool: Whether an End portal takes anything into the End. Off, the portal does nothing going in, and a ship is the only way there. Leaving the End by portal always works.
expedition.configuration.netherPortals.t: Whether a Nether portal takes anything into the Nether. Off, the portal still lights but does nothing going in, and a ship is the only way there. Leaving the Nether by portal always works.
expedition.configuration.portals.tooltip: Nether and End portals. Both work as in vanilla by default. Turned off, entering one does nothing; leaving the Nether or the End by portal always works.
expedition.configuration.ships.tooltip: The server's ceiling on a ship's box. This is a technical limit, not a game rule: it keeps one move from stalling the server. Raising it makes the largest moves longer and heavier on memory.
expedition.configuration.voidMargin.tool: Blocks of terrain kept past a planet's border. Chunks wholly beyond are left empty. -1 keeps terrain everywhere.
expedition.move.limit.hop_volume: The ship's box holds %s blocks; this server allows %s for a hop onto its own space (%s over).
expedition.move.limit.longest_side: The ship's box is %s blocks along its longest side; this server allows %s (%s over).
expedition.move.limit.volume: The ship's box holds %s blocks; this server allows %s (%s over).

expedition.move.refusal.atmos_timed_out: The atmosphere simulation timed out before the move began; try again.

expedition.move.refusal.busy: Part of this space is already being moved.
expedition.move.refusal.handover_failed: The move couldn't be handed over to the atmosphere simulation.
expedition.move.refusal.hop_too_large: The ship is too large for a hop onto its own space on this server. Move it further, clear of itself.
expedition.move.refusal.immovable: The ship holds a block that can't be moved.
expedition.move.refusal.no_drive: The ship has no drive with an open nozzle.

expedition.move.refusal.too_large: The ship is larger than this server allows.
expedition.move.refusal.unloaded: Part of the ship or its destination isn't loaded.
